messages.author: 1161df5ae7a276da
messages.subject: aspect ratio question
parts:
Hi all,

Quick question: 

In ggplot2, we can use coord_fixed() if we were interested in preserving aspect ratio.

In ggvis, we can get close by setting the domains in the axes, then using set_options(width = 600, height = 400, keep_aspect = TRUE).

This gets me 90% of the way there, but I was wondering if there is a way to tell ggvis to use the same scale-mapping ratio for both x & y axes without explicitly referring to the number of pixels.

Thanks,

Ian
